verdict.rationale: A runtime probe of the npm registry records the phaser package as MIT-licensed. MIT is a permissive license that imposes no royalties or per-install fees on games built with the framework. The paid licences on the pricing page cover the separate Editor and Agent tooling, and that page also notes that games created "are not linked to the licence". Missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly stating the MIT license and no royalties for the framework, independent or community corroboration of the licensing terms, and clarity on how the paid Editor/Agent licences relate to the free framework.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the license is permissive with no royalties or per-install fees — I keep what my game earns

citations.quote: any games you created will still work — they are not linked to the licence.
